summary.business_type: Multi-country telehealth / online GP provider (IE, ES, PT, CZ, BR, RO)
top_findings: Google is not ranking real country pages for any tested query — legacy Wix-era URLs (/home, /es/home-sp, /post/*) still occupy the site's SERP presence; competitors take 100% of visible slots
~250+ noindexed locale-variant doctor URLs remain in sitemap.xml (68% of sampled doctor URLs), wasting crawl budget
Cookie consent modal fully covers primary CTA on mobile on every page tested (site-wide component issue)
Homepage mobile: LCP 3.04s with 82% JS-gated render delay on hero H1; ~30s main-thread work, TBT 1,840ms; /ireland/en TBT 2,970ms
Homepage is a 162-word country gate with zero E-E-A-T signals and zero outbound internal links — crawl-depth risk for all country pages
quick_wins: Add <link rel="alternate" hreflang> head tags in generateMetadata for [country]/[lang] routes (currently sitemap-only)
Deploy commit 6a756ff1 — legal-page BreadcrumbList is committed but not live
Surface €29 price as visible hero badge on /ireland/en (currently meta-description only)
Fix mojibake: em-dash renders as "�" across homepage, blog, doctor pages
Serve service-page hero via Next/Image instead of raw /api/media proxy (LCP 4.62s → resource load is 3.6s of it)
Add internal links from the homepage gate to country pages

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt current with 2026 AI-crawler tokens; Railway fallback domain verified noindexed at edge
Single-hop apex→www 301 with HSTS; full security header set incl. enforcing CSP
100% SSR — zero JS-rendering dependency for crawlers; self-referencing canonicals on all 64 sampled URLs
sitemap.xml: 1,422 URLs, valid, 0 duplicates, correct hreflang reciprocity

findings.title: hreflang only in sitemap, not in page <head>
findings.description: 0 <link rel=alternate hreflang> matches on /ireland/en and /about; single-channel signal is fragile for a 6-market site
findings.recommendation: Emit matching hreflang head tags in generateMetadata for [country]/[lang] routes

findings.title: 250+ noindexed doctor URLs in sitemap
findings.description: 13/19 sampled locale-variant doctor-profile URLs are noindex,nofollow yet listed in sitemap.xml (381 doctor URLs total)
findings.recommendation: Exclude noindexed locale variants from sitemap generation; root cause is the locale-resolution/market-row gap

findings.title: /legal/* routes 404 site-wide
findings.description: Ingested legal/compliance content (complaints procedure, cookie policy) has no live page
findings.recommendation: Ship the legal routes or remove references

findings.title: Legal pages global-only in sitemap
findings.description: No per-country privacy/terms variants despite country-specific compliance content in codebase
findings.recommendation: Add per-country legal URLs once routes exist

findings.title: Portuguese slugs under /brazil/en and /brazil/es
findings.description: e.g. segunda-opiniao-medica under English/Spanish locale paths
findings.recommendation: Confirm intentional vs localization gap

findings.title: lastmod missing on 92% of sitemap URLs
findings.description: Present values are batch/migration timestamps, not real edit dates
findings.recommendation: Wire lastmod to content updatedAt; strip priority/changefreq (ignored)

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Doctor profiles: named clinicians, IMC registration numbers, Physician schema
Blog post diabetes-a-silent-disease: 4,023 words, credentialed author, last-reviewed date, HSE/peer-reviewed citations — textbook YMYL quality
Country home pages genuinely localized, not boilerplate
GDPR/DPC, IMC verify links, emergency-112 disclaimer present

findings.title: Homepage is a 162-word country gate
findings.description: Far under 500-word floor, zero E-E-A-T signals, zero internal links
findings.recommendation: Add trust content, stats, and country links to the gate page

findings.title: Only 2 blog articles total
findings.description: Insufficient topical authority for a YMYL brand across 6 markets
findings.recommendation: Editorial calendar; replicate the diabetes-article template

findings.title: Generic 'Reviewed by licensed doctors' on service pages and /about
findings.description: No named reviewer + date, unlike blog
findings.recommendation: Named clinical reviewer + review date on every medical page

findings.title: No external authoritative citations outside one blog post
findings.description: Service/doctor pages cite nothing (WHO/NHS/HSE/PubMed)
findings.recommendation: Add sourced citations to service pages

findings.title: Mojibake: em-dash renders as "�"
findings.description: Recurring across homepage, blog, doctor pages — charset/CMS encoding issue
findings.recommendation: Fix encoding at CMS ingestion or render layer

findings.title: Blog listing H1 reads as placeholder copy
findings.description: Unedited copy on blog index
findings.recommendation: Rewrite H1/intro

categories.name: On-Page & Search Experience
what_works: /ireland/en is the correct page type for the money queries: 1,860 words, 11 H2s, 5 schema blocks, €29/same-day/IMC in meta
SERP consensus (local/transactional service page) matches the page's actual pattern

findings.title: Real country pages absent from Google for all tested queries
findings.description: Legacy Wix URLs (/home, /es/home-sp, /post/*) are what Google shows site-scoped; competitors (webdoctor.ie, gpdoctor.ie, eirdoc.com, dronline.ie, medis.pt) hold 100% of visible slots
findings.recommendation: GSC: submit /ireland/en and country pages; reconcile legacy Wix URL redirects; add internal links from homepage gate

findings.title: €29 price not visible on-page above fold
findings.description: Price shopper persona scored 14/25; price lives only in meta description
findings.recommendation: Hero price badge on country/service pages

findings.title: Multi-country/11-language USP buried
findings.description: The one differentiator vs all competitors found is not headlined
findings.recommendation: Make multilingual credential angle the headline USP

findings.title: No single-purpose landers for sick-cert/prescription
findings.description: Single-purpose competitors rank on exact-match intent
findings.recommendation: Consider dedicated sick-cert and prescription landers per market

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Sitewide MedicalOrganization with CRO/IČO/NRPZS identifiers + regulator sameAs
Physician with hasCredential→recognizedBy + IMC identifier on doctor pages and as Article author/reviewedBy
Valid Service + MedicalProcedure + 16 Offers with price/currency on service page; correct BreadcrumbList on main templates
All JSON-LD in raw HTML (no client injection), no deprecated types, no placeholders

findings.title: Legal-page BreadcrumbList not live in production
findings.description: Commit 6a756ff1 adds it but production doesn't serve it — deploy gap, not code gap
findings.recommendation: Deploy the commit

findings.title: Article.publisher missing logo ImageObject
findings.description: Required for Article rich-result eligibility
findings.recommendation: Add publisher logo

findings.title: No @id entity linking
findings.description: Repeated Org/Physician/Service blocks not linked as one graph
findings.recommendation: Add @id and reference across blocks

findings.title: No AggregateRating/Review schema
findings.description: Doctify integration exists but no review schema detected server-side
findings.recommendation: Check if Doctify emits schema client-side; consider server-side aggregate

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Desktop Lighthouse 96-98 on all three pages
CLS = 0 everywhere

findings.title: Homepage mobile LCP 3.04s — 82% element render delay
findings.description: LCP element is hero H1 text; JS-gated reveal blocks text paint (known reveal-system pattern)
findings.recommendation: Ensure hero H1 paints without JS gate on mobile

findings.title: Homepage ~30s mobile main-thread work, TBT 1,840ms
findings.description: Style&Layout 10.3s + Rendering 8.9s — points to animation/observer loop, not one-time hydration
findings.recommendation: Profile the reveal/IO system on mobile; throttle or disable animation loops

findings.title: /ireland/en TBT 2,970ms mobile
findings.description: Worst TBT of the three despite good LCP; route-specific client components hydrating heavily
findings.recommendation: Audit client components on country home route

findings.title: Service-page hero LCP 4.62s — 3.6s resource load
findings.description: Hero served raw via /api/media proxy, bypassing Next/Image optimization
findings.recommendation: Route service hero images through Next/Image

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended
llms.txt present and well-structured (6 countries × 5 page types)
Full SSR — zero JS-rendering risk for AI crawlers; strong schema on service pages

findings.title: No sourced statistics anywhere
findings.description: No doctor counts, wait times, consultation volume — nothing citable
findings.recommendation: Add sourced stats to hero/answer blocks

findings.title: Answer passages too short (35-80 words vs 134-167 optimal)
findings.description: Direct-answer-first structure right, length wrong
findings.recommendation: Lengthen key answers into the optimal band

findings.title: No visible author/reviewer/date bylines on About/FAQ/service pages
findings.description: YMYL trust gap for AI citation
findings.recommendation: Add bylines (overlaps content findings)

findings.title: CCBot not individually addressed
findings.description: Implicitly allowed via wildcard; decide training-exclusion policy
findings.recommendation: Explicit CCBot policy + consider RSL licensing section in llms.txt

categories.name: Images & Visual
what_works: No horizontal scroll on any page/viewport; H1 above fold on all 6 device/page combos
Tap targets meet 48px minimum; hero contrast good

findings.title: Cookie modal covers primary CTA on mobile, site-wide
findings.description: Country picker, Book Appointment, and Book-this-service CTAs all obscured on the 3 pages tested
findings.recommendation: Reduce banner height or reposition so primary CTA stays visible

findings.title: Cookie banner clips country-picker card on desktop home
findings.description: Portugal row clipped — cosmetic
findings.recommendation: Same fix covers it

findings.title: Service hero image unoptimized
findings.description: Raw /api/media delivery (see Performance)
findings.recommendation: Next/Image
